explanation: Encodes Erdős's question liminf (Σ d_{i+1}/d_i - τ(n) - log n) < ∞ as 'bounded by some C infinitely often'. It is correctly marked solved, since it follows from the main result. Writing r_i for the ratios, Σ(r_i - 1 - log r_i) ≤ Σ(r_i - 1)², and log n = Σ log r_i, so boundedness of h_2 along a sequence suffices.
